subject: Cross-currency unapplied receipts affecting AR aging — revenue mapping needed
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Finance Team <finance@redwood.ai>; Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Cross-currency unapplied receipts — quick triage

Team,

Quick heads up: Treasury flagged a batch of EUR receipts on 2025-08-12 that did not auto-apply against outstanding USD invoices for NimbusCloud (see attached remit file). Our AR aging shows a ~€120k variance in the EU ledger bucket that looks like unapplied cash. Early signal is FX posting mismatch in the remittance import mapping — currency coded as EUR but our invoice entities are USD-with-eu-tax (we're seeing currency conversion routed through the wrong ledger code).

Action items I need this week:
- Can someone pull the AR export for invoices referenced in the remit file and surface the open invoice IDs? (attached: ar_export_aug_12.xlsx)
- Confirm whether receipts landed to the suspense account or were posted to revenue ledgers incorrectly.
- If postings are wrong, propose journal correction entries and I'll route for approval.

I've looped Laura for allocation and Grace for journal guidance. External has been asked for the original remittance but we might need to propose a reconciliation before we ask legal/ops for credits.

Attachments: nimbus_remit_20250812.csv, ar_export_aug_12.xlsx

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cross-currency unapplied receipts — quick triage

Vivek,

Thanks — I pulled the AR export and matched the 2025-08-12 remit. Summary so far:
- Remit references 6 invoice numbers across 3 legal entities; 4 invoices were denominated USD but have EU VAT lines.
- Payments were received in EUR and posted to cash EUR bank account. The import rule matched on invoice currency and, because invoices are USD, the system created unapplied receipts in the EUR suspense line instead of posting a currency-conversion payment application.

Preliminary proposal:
1) Create JV to move the EUR suspense receipts to the USD AR clearing account (FX realized at bank conversion rate on 2025-08-12).
2) Apply converted amounts to the referenced invoices so AR aging reflects applied status.
3) Post small FX variance to P&L (we can offset with month-end FX reserve if material).

I'll prepare a CSV of the proposed journal lines (using the journal-correction-template.csv). Question for Grace: do we need an adjustment to revenue recognition mapping given VAT tagged invoices were paid in a different currency? My sense is the revenue recognition is unchanged — this is purely cash application — but want an accounting sign-off.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior AR Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 08:17:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Payment - file attached

Hi Laura and Vivek,

Thanks for flagging. I've attached the original payment file from our payments provider and the remittance detail — apologize for the confusion. We batch-pay in EUR from our EU treasury but some of the invoices are billed in USD. Our AP system includes an "apply by invoice number" field but apparently the currency tag wasn't set for the batch.

We see the open invoices on our side as cleared; happy to provide bank confirmation if that helps. We would prefer Redwood posts the application so the customer ledger shows cleared status (we can provide any required proof).

Attachments: payments_remit_provider_0812.pdf

—Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Customer Payments, NimbusCloud

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cross-currency unapplied receipts — quick triage

All,

I reviewed Laura's export and the external remit. Accounting position: this is a cash-application processing issue, not a revenue recognition event. Proposed correction flow (low-risk):
- Journal (JV) to reclass EUR suspense -> USD AR clearing using bank conversion rate 2025-08-12 (FX line to "FX revaluation" GL).
- Apply receipts to invoice IDs as Laura outlined.
- Document FX variances in month-end pack; if variance > €5k escalate to FP&A for reserve treatment.

I attached a filled template (journal-correction-template.csv) with suggested debit/credit GLs and amounts. Please review and mark approved/need-change. Once approved, I'll create the JV and tag FIN-1324 in Jira for auditable trail.

Grace
Grace O'Connor
Accounting Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: journal-correction-template.csv]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Elena Morales <elena@nimbuscloud.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cross-currency unapplied receipts — quick triage

Thanks everyone — good alignment. Next steps (owner):
- Laura: finalize the invoice-to-payment mapping and upload the CSV with applied amounts to the Jira ticket FIN-1324 (owner: Laura). Deadline EOD Wed 2025-08-20.
- Grace: prepare and submit the JV in NetSuite, include the bank conversion rate and attach the provider proof. Mark JV with FIN-1324. Deadline Thu 2025-08-21.
- Elena: please leave the payments reference open on your side until we confirm application (we'll message you when complete).

I'll route the JV for expedited approval once Grace submits. Laura — cc me on the Jira comment.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
